output.summary: Deciduous fern native to Europe, North Africa and West Asia, growing in woodland bogs and beside streams. Its stout underground stems can eventually form a woody, trunk-like base, while brown spore-bearing tips make some fronds resemble flowers.
output.edibilityNote: In some places, young shoots called fiddleheads are eaten and said to taste like asparagus; the source marks this claim citation needed.
